sequential_design.stage1_decision: p000 passed x01 and failed x02 without ambiguity

mechanism_audit.observed_edit_shape: p100 changed exactly observer.py, shared.py, and target.py in both repetitions
mechanism_audit.semantic_limitation: the p100 Profile required observer to preserve raw input, so the produced shared reachability helper rebuilt adjacency inside every batch instead of preprocessing once in observer
mechanism_audit.consequence: the path-count topology manipulation passed, but it did not realize the intended cross-batch coordinated optimization
mechanism_audit.interpretation: edit topology is controlled; mechanism suitability is not guaranteed by topology alone

conclusions.profile_changes_agent_behavior: observed prospectively through reproducible local versus three-module edit shapes
conclusions.profile_effect_is_task_dependent: p000 is eligible and cost-saving on x01 but performance-ineligible on x02
conclusions.task_selective_profile_routing_can_reduc: the frozen route saves 25.0% per deployment versus fixed neutral while preserving correctness and performance gates
conclusions.profile_control_is_not_yet_mechanism_con: p100 controlled touched modules but not placement of reusable preprocessing

next_experiment: repair the E1 Profile as a mechanism-aware preprocessing contract on a development workload, then freeze a different held-out multi-batch task; do not reinterpret or rerun P1e as confirmatory evidence
claim_boundary: This one-family pilot prospectively supports controllable Profile behavior, a Profile-task interaction, and a 25.0% quality-constrained worker-token opportunity. It rejects net token benefit at the frozen eight-deployment horizon and does not establish broad Router generalization or semantic mechanism control.
